paragraphs: I'm a final-year BCA student at BIT Mesra, Jaipur, and the founder of LLMSlim, open source context infrastructure for AI agents, built under my studio AMEYOR. Most recently I was an AI/ML research intern at DRDO's Scientific Analysis Group. I also take on freelance work: Python backends, retrieval systems, AI features, and getting a prototype into someone's hands.
